g1.flow: Four surah openings. Az-Zumar 39:1 alone has no Ḥā Mīm before it; next, 'We sent down to you the Book in truth'. Ghāfir 40:2 alone ends al-ʿalīm (the Knowing); next, 'forgiver of sin'. Al-Jāthiyah 45:2 and Al-Aḥqāf 46:2 match word for word: Al-Jāthiyah moves to signs in the heavens and earth, Al-Aḥqāf to 'not created except in truth'. Hook: ḥakīm, ʿalīm, ḥakīm, ḥakīm; Ghāfir is the odd one.

cues.39:1: Az-Zumar: first ayah, no Ḥā Mīm before; ends al-ḥakīm; next, 'sent down to you in truth'.
cues.40:2: Ghāfir: ends al-ʿalīm (the Knowing); next, 'forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance'.
cues.45:2: Al-Jāthiyah: ends al-ḥakīm; next, 'within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers'.
cues.46:2: Al-Aḥqāf: ends al-ḥakīm; next, 'We did not create the heavens and earth except in truth'.

g2.flow: All end wa ḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziʾūn; two words change. An-Naḥl 16:34: fa-aṣābahum (they were struck) … mā ʿamilū, after 'they had been wronging themselves'. Az-Zumar 39:48: wa badā lahum … mā kasabū (earned), after the ransom ayah. Al-Jāthiyah 45:33: wa badā lahum … mā ʿamilū, after 'we know not what the Hour is'. Hook: Al-Jāthiyah takes badā from Az-Zumar and ʿamilū from An-Naḥl.

cues.16:34: Fa-aṣābahum … ʿamilū: after 'Allāh wronged them not, they wronged themselves'.
cues.39:48: Badā lahum … kasabū: after the ransom ayah, which also says 'there will appear to them'.
cues.45:33: Badā … ʿamilū: after 'we know not what the Hour is'; next, 'Today We forget you'.
